stem: Root-zone EC increases across three measurements while substrate water content declines faster than the previous comparable cycle. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: The trend supports investigating irrigation delivery and dryback together before changing nutrient concentration
The nutrient recipe is definitely wrong
The EC readings should be ignored
rationale: Rising EC together with faster dryback can reflect the interaction of water delivery and solute concentration, so irrigation history and representative root-zone evidence should be evaluated together.
